column3: ("Agni and Soma are these two. How is hospitality made to Soma and not to Agni? ... for the oblation brought near.")
column4: ಅಗ್ನಿಶ್ಚ ವಾ ಏತೌ ಸೋಮಶ್ಚ ಕಥಾ ಸೋಮಾಯಾತಿಥ್ಯಂ ... ಸರ್ವಾ ದೇವತಾ ಜನಯತಿ ॥
column5: An English translation of the Taittiriya quotation is added although the Kannada only paraphrases it afterwards and does not translate it.
